resources.string: Visibility for a requested XMouse network-device session.
XMouse is preparing or maintaining a requested network-device connection.
Start a foreground session for the selected host. To avoid two SSH connections, disconnect any existing in-app connection first.
A foreground session is active. You can return to the XMouse controls or disconnect this session here.
A foreground session request is waiting for notification permission or host selection. Continue that request or disconnect it before starting another SSH connection.
Android may hide this session from the notification drawer. Its foreground-service notice remains available in Android Task Manager. Use Disconnect here to stop the session.
Notification settings may hide the notification-drawer actions. Use Disconnect here to stop the session.
A foreground XMouse session is being prepared or is active. Use Session controls to continue or disconnect it before starting another SSH connection.
The existing in-app connection is still active or connecting. Disconnect it before starting a foreground session to avoid a second SSH connection.

Android 13 and later uses notification permission to show XMouse Open controls and Disconnect actions in the notification drawer. If you deny it, the foreground session can still run, but its notice is shown in Android Task Manager rather than the drawer. You can always disconnect from Session controls in XMouse.

The foreground session may not appear in the notification drawer, so its Open controls and Disconnect actions may be unavailable there. Android still discloses the running foreground service in Task Manager. XMouse Session controls remain available in the app.

Android will not show another permission prompt after this choice. Open XMouse notification settings to restore notification-drawer actions, or continue without them. The session remains disclosed by Android, and you can disconnect from Session controls in XMouse.
This Android version does not use the notification runtime permission. Notification or channel settings may hide drawer actions; use Session controls in XMouse to disconnect.
Android could not start the foreground session from this screen. Keep XMouse visible and try again.

Android 17 requires permission before XMouse can resolve a computer or connect to it on your local network. Grant access before continuing; host-key trust and SSH authentication checks still apply afterward.

XMouse did not resolve the host or start SSH because local network access was denied. Grant Local network access in Android settings, then deliberately retry. Your saved host and authentication settings are unchanged.
Searching for advertised SSH computers. Running SSH alone may not advertise a service. You can enter a hostname or IP manually.
Android 17 requires local-network access to search for computers. Grant access when prompted, or use manual entry.
Local network access was denied. Discovery did not start. Grant access in Android settings and retry, or enter a hostname or IP manually.
Could not search for advertised SSH computers. Check local-network access and retry, or enter a hostname or IP manually.
Select a computer to prefill its endpoint and port. No username or password is supplied.
Tap to select. Touch and hold, then drag onto the first or second half of another button to insert before or after it. Preview interactions do not run remote commands.
Release to place at position %1$d, row %2$d (%3$d columns).
Drag onto another button to choose a placement. Releasing here leaves the draft unchanged.
This layout has no buttons yet.
Select a button to inspect its properties and validation.
Required title, width, and color are valid.
Button arrangement and properties remain unchanged until saved.
Save the draft, discard it, or keep editing.
Keep at least one saved layout. The last layout cannot be deleted.
